review.methodology: Each case was judged by reading the profile fixture and the job description as documents, deciding what a careful hiring reviewer would conclude, and writing the rationale BEFORE any matcher was run. The reviewer rules are set out in README.md and were fixed before the first verdict was written. Judgments where a second careful reader could reasonably differ are flagged `contested` with the disagreement recorded, and are reported separately from the rest.
review.independence_statement: No verdict in this file was produced, suggested, adjusted or confirmed by matching_v1 or by any other matcher. The rationales cite only the profile and the posting. Where matching_v1 disagrees with a verdict here, the disagreement is the measurement; it is not evidence that this file is wrong, and this file must not be edited to agree with any algorithm. Correcting a verdict is permitted only on the grounds that a reviewer misread the profile or the posting, and requires the rationale to change accordingly.
